stories.title: Introduire l’alias cfg unique du backend Ghostty

local_gates_passed: cargo test -p paneflow-app --test ghostty_cfg_policy: 2 passed, plus a standalone negative control (rustc --test against a tree containing the forbidden motif) that fails as expected
local_gates_blocked: QG-002 Linux and Windows neutrality: cannot be produced on an Apple Silicon dev machine, needs the CI matrix on the candidate commit.
verification.environment_note: Building paneflow-app on macOS requires full Xcode, not Command Line Tools: gpui_macos compiles src/shaders.metal in its build script via `xcrun metal`, and on Xcode 26+ the Metal toolchain is a separately downloaded component. `cmake` is also required transitively by wasmtime-c-api-impl.
verification.note: QG-001 est vert sur aarch64-apple-darwin. Le refactor est prouvé complet par inventaire avant/après (172 -> 5 expressions restantes, toutes intentionnelles). Seul l'arm macOS (alias absent) a été compilé; les arms Linux et Windows ne peuvent l'être que par la CI. US-001 reste IN_PROGRESS jusqu'à QG-002.

stories.title: Fermer le spike de build Mach-O reproductible

inputs_confirmed: Zig 0.15.2 aarch64-macos sha256 3cc2bab367e185cdfb27501c4b30b1b0653c28d9f73df8dc91488e66ece5fa6b matches the official ziglang.org download index

reproducibility.method: scripts/build-libghostty-macos.sh --verify-reproducible: two builds from two clean Zig caches, archive/header/bindings/build-info compared with cmp
reproducibility.caveat: Produced on a developer machine using an xcrun shim to reach SDK 15. Not the reviewed hash: strip comes from the host Xcode, so the manifest key must be filled from a CI run.

environment_constraint: Apple dropped the arm64-macos slice from libSystem.tbd in the macOS 26 SDK; MacOSX15.0.sdk has it, MacOSX26.5.sdk and MacOSX27.0.sdk do not. Zig 0.15.2's Mach-O linker matches the slice exactly, so it cannot link its own build runner against a 26+ SDK. The CI lane pins a macOS 15 runner image and asserts the slice before building.
verification.note: La question centrale d'US-002 est répondue: l'archive est reproductible bit à bit. Reste à produire le hash reviewé sur CI avant de l'inscrire au manifest (US-003).
